supporting_ids: s2:Beaming as an explanation of the repetition/width relation in FRBs
rationale: The papers 'Beaming as an explanation of the repetition/width relation in FRBs', 'CHIME/FRB Discovery of 25 Repeating Fast Radio Burst Sources', and 'The Statistical Similarity of Repeating and Non-Repeating Fast Radio Bursts' provide insights into the characteristics and distributions of repeating and non-repeating FRBs, contributing evidence that addresses the question of why FRB 121102 is unique in its repetition.
